_comment: Frozen vectors. Both implementations (src/identity.ts canonical, reference/identity.py) MUST reproduce every 'expected' value byte-for-byte. Verified cross-language on generation. Regenerate ONLY with a reviewed run; changing these silently breaks every derived identity.

vectors.name: passphrase-only-book-demo
vectors.note: Weakest valid config. Book Appendix B words. Demo only; not a recommended key composition.

vectors.name: ordering-sensitivity
vectors.note: Same factors as book-demo, reordered. MUST produce a DIFFERENT identity (order is part of the secret, SPEC 3.6). Verified distinct from passphrase-only-book-demo.

vectors.name: below-entropy-floor
vectors.note: Total estimated entropy below 128 bits. Derivation MUST throw (SPEC 3.2).
